subject: Official Manuscript Guidelines - Editorial
instructionString:
Editor-in-Chief,

Format the official editorial stance regarding student budget cuts:

1. Format the Student Demands as a NUMBERED LIST (1, 2, 3).
2. Format the Key Supporting Points as a BULLETED LIST (•).

- Mr. Reyes

startingTextBlocks.text: The student body hereby submits the following official demands regarding recent unauthorized budget reallocations:
Immediate restoration of all diverted student activity funds to original allocations.
Publication of itemized maintenance expenditure reports for public review.
Strict adherence to Article IV, Section 2 of the Student Council Charter prohibiting unilateral fund transfers.
Unilateral fund diversion directly compromises student journalism and athletic facilities.
Official administrative responses must be documented and made accessible to all students.
